band.combination: All three inclusive limits must hold at both interval endpoints.
band.position_reference: The supplied trace reset world XY position.

standing.sampling: Sum complete recorded intervals with both endpoints in band, left endpoint at/after settling, and right endpoint at/before horizon. No interpolation or time after first termination. Intervals straddling a window boundary are omitted.
standing.scope: Common physical criteria for a complete first episode, independent of the training reward. These declared bands are experiment criteria, not established hardware acceptance limits. Compare standing duration together with survival and horizon status; an early death with little displacement is not evidence of better balance.
